mathematical_contract.quadratic_axis: For P=A0+x*A1+x^2*A2 over the exact bivariate coefficient ring, any split into two linear-x factors has discriminant Delta=A1^2-4*A0*A2 equal to an exact bivariate square S^2.
mathematical_contract.square_root: The square root is reconstructed from the leading exact term under lexicographic monomial order. Each next coefficient is forced by the leading root coefficient; the dense residual is updated exactly and acceptance requires a structurally zero final residual.
mathematical_contract.candidate_factors: The quadratic formula supplies coefficient pairs (A1+S,2*A2) and (A1-S,2*A2). Exact univariate-axis content and Hypersolve positive-dimensional bivariate components are divided from each pair until primitive, because either raw pair may contain the other factor's leading coefficient.
mathematical_contract.division_authority: Each proposed constant+linear*x factor is divided from the complete trivariate tensor by descending bivariate-coefficient division. Every intermediate bivariate remainder and the final constant remainder must be exactly zero; the discriminant alone never authorizes a factor.
mathematical_contract.selected_sign: Both verified factors replay Hypercurve's existing STRICT structural, Bernstein, affine, selected-linear-resultant, and binary-relation authorities. A selected zero factor proves the product zero. Two decided nonzero signs are multiplied exactly.
mathematical_contract.resource_bound: All bivariate products and reconstructed trivariate tensors use checked dimensions and the existing 16384-control ceiling. The complete package is cold and feature-local; minimal builds retain their prior code and storage graph byte-for-byte.
mathematical_contract.policy: A supportable quadratic factorization is Certified under STRICT and APPROXIMATE_512 without terminal consumption. A higher-degree coupled control remains Predicate uncertainty in STRICT and may return Zero only after APPROXIMATE_512 records Approximate512Consumed.
mathematical_contract.failure: Nonsquare discriminants, unresolved exact coefficient signs, failed component extraction, failed exact division, resource overflow, and higher-degree axes make no exact claim. No tolerance, sampled factor, guessed square root, compatibility shim, or second Boolean engine is introduced.

capability.comparison_revision: The zero (a*b-c*(a+b))*(1+a*b+a*c+b*c) has no univariate axis content and is quadratic in every axis. STRICT was Predicate uncertainty and APPROXIMATE_512 consumed its terminal.
capability.source_revision: The coupled tensor has an exact-square discriminant on every axis. Content removal recovers the two authored multi-affine factors, exact tensor division verifies them, and the existing linear-axis selected-root authority proves a*b-c*(a+b)=0.
capability.certified_fixture: The formerly terminal coupled rational three-field fixture returns Certified Zero under STRICT and APPROXIMATE_512; neither policy consumes the approximate terminal.
capability.differential_factor_coverage: Two dense signed products of independently authored multi-affine tensors split and reconstruct exactly on all three axes. A negative-times-positive product returns the exact Negative sign, and x^2+1 rejects its nonsquare discriminant.
capability.remaining_policy_control: The same zero factor multiplied by (1+a*b+a*c+b*c)^2 is cubic in every axis. The quadratic package deliberately declines it; STRICT remains explicitly uncertain and APPROXIMATE_512 returns Zero only with Approximate512Consumed.
capability.remaining_exactness_boundary: Extend exact factor recovery to bounded higher axis degrees, or construct a bounded compositum only when quotient, relation, axis-content, and quadratic-factor paths all fail.
